reader.requirement: At --std 85 an OPEN INPUT of a sequential file whose SELECT has OPTIONAL and whose physical file is absent must succeed (status 05, VII.1.3.5) and leave the file position indicator in the 'optional input file not present' state, so the first sequential READ takes the at end condition (10) and the OPEN does not create the file; this holds for fixed and RECORD VARYING files and with the REVERSED and NO REWIND phrases.

edition-consulted.switches: FileConnector.SharingFacilityInEffect (DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility, 2002): Table 19 arbitration and '61' are skipped at 85; the OPTIONAL-absent arm is not touched
the default sharing mode is ALL OTHER at 85 versus READ ONLY or NO OTHER from 2002
OPEN REVERSED is admitted at 85 and refused COBOL0902 from 2002

reader.edition-search: grep of Runtime/IO for Edition, DialectBehavior, SharingFacilityInEffect; the INPUT arm of SequentialConnector.OpenCore and SequentialReadGuard read no edition: the GR13 behaviour is one arm for every edition
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the GR13 arm is the same code at 85 and 2023; only the sharing arbitration around the OPEN and the REVERSED admission differ, and neither changes the result for this rule
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1_open_optional_input_absent covers fixed sequential, relative and indexed files; it does not cover RECORD VARYING, the REVERSED or NO REWIND phrase on an absent optional file, or the second READ after the at end

probes.printed: Q-OPEN=05 Q-ATEND1 10 Q-READ2=46 Q-CLOSE=00 Q-AGAIN=05 V-OPEN=05 V-ATEND 10 R-OPEN-REV=05 R-ATEND 10 R-CLOSE=00 R-OPEN-NR=07 R-ATEND-NR 10 N-OPEN=35 N-READ=47
probes.expected: 05 on OPEN; 10 on the first READ; 46 on the next READ (VII.1.3.5 4e2); file not created so the re-OPEN is 05 again; RECORD VARYING and REVERSED the same; NO REWIND on a non-reel medium may give 07 since both 05 and 07 apply and the implementor picks; a non-optional absent file is 35 and the READ after it is 47

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.4.3.4 GR13  (4.3.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR13
OK  §1985:VII.1.3.5  (1.3.5 I-O Status)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.2a.2

reader.notes: The absent optional INPUT arm sets OptionalAbsent and returns 05. SequentialReadGuard turns that into '10' once, and the LastReadUnsuccessful poison makes the next READ 46. OpenOnceEntered clears OptionalAbsent at every OPEN, so a re-OPEN re-probes and gives 05 again: the file is not created.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VII.4.3.4 GR13 with GR1 Table 1 and VII.1.3.5 (05, 10 item 2, 46) and SequentialConnector.OpenCore's INPUT arm. Probes at --std 85 under refute-1985-122: r21a.cob (OPTIONAL file assigned into a missing directory) printed IN-OPEN=05 / IN-ATEND 10 / IN-CLOSE=00; r14b.cob printed F3-OPEN=05 / F3-ATEND 10, then after a second SELECT of the same physical file created it, the re-OPEN of the optional SELECT gave F3-REOPEN=00 / F3-READ=00 B001, and OPEN INPUT F3 F1 gave MULTI=00 00 (GR24); r13c.cob (the 2002 OPEN SHARING phrase) is refused at 85: error COBOL0900. All as the 1985 text requires. cite.py: OK §1985:VII.4.3.4 GR13 (the text is in GR13).
